data_access_mode.description: selected_context = invocation-only (one-shot, user-initiated); full_room_member = continuous access and reads all Room content (ADR-0129 rule 3)

trigger_filter.description: event classes/scopes that wake the service or that it may act on; limits automation, never what a full member can read (ADR-0129 rule 3)

state_head.description: ServiceControlState version+hash the installation was admitted under (ADR-0129 rule 6)
